fieldValues.title: The record holds more than a published page should print
fieldValues.summary: muSrs sources carry working notes (why it matters here, where it was read) that the default source view prints, which made the essay's reference list about 133,000 characters; publishing needed separate short views, and the full notes now travel only in the record.
evidence: Rendered essay with source-citation-view: References section 132,788 characters; with publication-source-view: citation and URL only, whole render 81,308 characters
fieldValues.body: This is the carrier's main benefit in one example: the page can be short and readable because the record carries the rest. A publication needs its own views; the default reader views are written for the workspace.
